label: There exists an actual concrete root n of the profile selected relation at w, n exists at every…
paraphrase: There exists an actual concrete root n of the profile selected relation at w, n exists at every world accessible from w, and every actual concrete root of that relation at w equals n. Necessary nonroots are not excluded. No other-world rootness, well-foundedness, universal ancestry, efficient-cause interpretation, firstness in a separate priority, potency-freeness or God identity is asserted.
